text:
sasha: kicking off squeeze-and-release FF window for feature/llm-routing — small canary, then step up if metrics look good :eyes:

jen: thanks — what's the plan for cohorts and duration?

sasha: plan:
- 1% for 10m
- 5% for 15m
- 25% for 20m
- hold for 30m before full enable

tom: put a hard holdpoint at 25% rn. if p95 latency > 350ms or error-rate delta > 0.5% we rollback to pinned v=2026-04-02

sasha: noted. pin is already set to v2026-04-02 for affected model routing. will only unpin after final signoff.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary rollout started for feature/llm-routing on canary pool-7 at 2026-04-12T15:02:13Z — ticket #ENG-4121

ops-bot: telemetry hooks attached: rps, p95, error-rate, kv-cache-hit, model-quantization-path. alerts set: p95>350ms (sev2), errors >0.5% (sev1)

lee: adding a quick smoke check script to the thread:
```
# smoke test load
for i in {1..20}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq -r .id; done
```

jen: looks good. I'll watch the dashboard - will call for hold if anything weird.

sasha: 1% done. no anomalous spikes so far. moving to 5% in 2m.

deploy-bot: [deploy] traffic shifted to 5% at 2026-04-12T15:15:04Z

tom: quick note — enable sampling of full traces for 5% cohort for the next 30m (helpful if we need to bisect)

ops-bot: sampling enabled for cohort=ff_llm_routing:5pct

jen: at 5% p95=310ms, errors +0.07% — within tolerance :thumbsup:

sasha: stepping to 25% now, but leaving auto-drain window enabled. pinned fallback remains.

deploy-bot: [deploy] traffic shifted to 25% at 2026-04-12T15:42:51Z

jen: p95 climbed to 360ms — crossing threshold. raising a hold.

tom: on hold. initiating rollback to pinned v2026-04-02 and draining cohorts.

deploy-bot: [rollback] initiating rollback to v2026-04-02 — draining ff cohorts back to 0% at 2026-04-12T15:45:10Z :warning:

lee: logs show degraded KV cache warmup on new variant, causing extra latency for first 6 tokens. looks like cache warming config missed in this build.

sasha: good catch. will patch cache warmup and re-run a tighter canary with warmup patch before reattempt.

jen: updating release notes and the ticket: add rollback reason, KV warmup missing, next steps = patch + 1% soak for 20m + 5% for 30m with tracing.

tom: add a postmortem blurb to ensure cache warmup is part of preflight checklist for model variant deploys.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollback completed at 2026-04-12T15:51:03Z — traffic back to baseline.

sasha: thanks all. replan: hotfix branch with cache-warmup config, run an A/B test in staging, then re-run squeeze window tomorrow during quiet window (0000-0400 UTC). will ping this thread when ready. :white_check_mark:
